title: A QuickBooks refusal lands on the QB Unexported report with the reason
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop is connected to QuickBooks, which refuses an invoice on a term of the shop's own.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The test organization is connected to a QuickBooks Online sandbox company, and you can sign in to that company in another tab.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds the shop's own term {Term-A}; its invoice will be refused by QuickBooks for a reason the sandbox gives today, and work order {Work-order-1} for it is complete.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-09 Customer with a tax code the sandbox does not accept, {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S8-09 Fourteen and {Work-order-1} is S2-15445.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. On {Work-order-1}'s Finance tab, click Create Invoice.
  2. Open the QB Unexported report.
  3. Fix the cause in the sandbox.
  4. Resend the invoice from the QB Unexported report.
  5. In QuickBooks, open the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the invoice is created; ShopView work goes on (nothing is blocked).
  • Step 2: the invoice is listed with the reason QuickBooks gave.
  • Step 3: the cause is fixed.
  • Step 4: it syncs and leaves the report.
  • Step 5: it shows terms {Term-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11677 (Story 8, QuickBooks sync - credit terms)

  • Story 8, Error Handling: “If QuickBooks refuses to create the term or the record, the record lands on the QB Unexported report with the reason QuickBooks gave, the existing failure path, and can be resent from there once fixed. ShopView work is never blocked.”
